use_case: The agent is asked to commit and push a bug fix. It has to follow the repo's AGENTS.md commit rules and leave out a file the user said is their own unfinished work.
situation: This is a freight quoting service. The agent fixed cubage rounding for ticket FRT-412 and regenerated a parquet fixture. The latest git status shows the fix plus the user's WIP carriers.yaml, the generated fixture and a debug script, all modified or untracked together.
must_keep: Keep the AGENTS.md commit section: scope format, the Refs trailer, no pushes to main, and data/fixtures/*.parquet excluded. Also keep the user's instruction to leave config/carriers.yaml out of every commit.
may_drop: The cubage source code, the patch details, test and build logs, git log history, the legacy CONTRIBUTING.md, and the end-of-session git status listing.
why_judges_fail: The final git status matches the goal best and seems to be all the agent needs, so a judge may drop the short early AGENTS.md rules and the user's offhand WIP note.
